description: This Java source file defines an enum 'EntityTables' representing database entity table metadata, including table names, foreign key columns, reference columns, and associated statuses for various entities in the Fineract project.

classes.name: EntityTables
classes.description: An enum representing database entity tables with associated metadata such as table names, foreign key columns, reference columns, and status checks.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the entity table.

methods.name: getApptableName
methods.description: Returns the application table name associated with the entity.

methods.name: getForeignKeyColumnNameOnDatatable
methods.description: Returns the foreign key column name on the data table.

methods.name: getRefColumn
methods.description: Returns the reference column name on the application table.

methods.name: getCheckStatuses
methods.description: Returns the list of statuses associated with the entity for validation.

methods.name: hasCheck
methods.description: Indicates whether the entity has associated status checks.

methods.name: getEntityNames
methods.description: Returns a list of all entity table names.

methods.name: fromEntityName
methods.description: Retrieves the EntityTables enum instance based on the entity name.

methods.name: getForeignKeyColumnNameOnDatatable (static)
methods.description: Static method to get foreign key column name for a given entity name.

methods.name: getCheckStatuses (static)
methods.description: Static method to get list of status enums for a given entity name.

methods.name: getCheckStatusCodes
methods.description: Returns list of integer codes for the statuses associated with the entity.

methods.name: getFiltered
methods.description: Filters EntityTables based on a predicate.
